text:
maria gonzalez: Heads up — CI started failing on the onboarding branch after the KMS rotation yesterday. SAST/DAST jobs finish, but secret-access checks are failing with 403s. Anyone seen this? :rotating_light:

samir patel: Which pipeline is failing? auth-ci or infra-ci?

maria gonzalez: infra-ci. The step that pulls the signing key for SBOM/uploading artifacts errors out. Logs show KMS AccessDenied.

samir patel: Can you paste the error snippet?

maria gonzalez: ```
ERROR: KMS:AccessDenied: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-1234
  Message: User: arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/ci-runner is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt
  Context: step=sign-artifacts ci_job=build-onboarding
```

sec-bot: :lock: Security alert created: SEC-4321 — KMS access denied in CI (automated detection). Link: https://redwood.example/SEC-4321

olivia chen: Looks like the key policy was tightened during the rotation. We scoped out principals and accidentally removed the CI role from the key policy grants. Short-term options: add a grant or revert the key policy change.

jordan-ops: Quick mitigation: create a one-off grant valid for 1 hour so deploys can continue, then fix policy. e.g.:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/redwood-cicd --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/ci-runner --operations Decrypt,DescribeKey --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"build":"onboarding"}
```

samir patel: That sound good. Long-term we should avoid granting broad Decrypt. Maybe add a small shim that uses a kms:GenerateDataKey flow for ephemeral keys used in CI.

maria gonzalez: Agreed. Immediate proposed plan: 1) jordan create temporary grant, 2) olivia update key policy to explicitly allow ci-runner with least privilege, 3) add a CI check using aws kms simulate-principal-policy to prevent regressions, 4) postmortem and ticket link in SEC-4321.

olivia chen: I'll own the policy change. For the CI check we can run a quick simulate call in pre-merge step:
```
aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/ci-runner --action-names kms:Decrypt kms:DescribeKey --resource-arns arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-1234
```
Add that to infra-ci so key rotations won't silently break pipelines.

qa-bot: Note: secret-scan job failed because it couldn't fetch KMS-backed secrets. Marked flaky in the run at 2026-03-19T14:02Z.

samir patel: Any audit/logging follow-ups? We should make sure CloudTrail has the key usage and we alert on CreateGrant and CreateKeyPolicy events.

olivia chen: Good call — I'll add CloudWatch rule for kms:CreateGrant and kms:PutKeyPolicy actions and route to sec-ops. Also ensure we keep key rotation audit in the rotation runbook.

maria gonzalez: Thanks everyone. Jordan, can you do the temporary grant now and DM me when done? I'll coordinate with infra to unblock the onboarding deploys. We'll run the simulate-principal-policy check in the next PR. :white_check_mark:

jordan-ops: On it, creating temporary grant and will update SEC-4321 with expiry time. :hammer_and_wrench:
